boards.title: Only Happens Here: 10 Traditions That Make No Sense Anywhere Else
boards.description: Ten documented UChicago rituals, annual events, and campus practices, from the Quad to the stage.

cards.title: Borrow art for your room
cards.subtitle: College Housing tradition
cards.notes: If you live in College housing, explore the Smart Museum lending program and choose an original work to keep in your room for the school year.
cards.short_summary: A campus program that lets College residents live with borrowed original art.
cards.evidence_claim: UChicago's Art to Live With program lets students in College housing borrow original Smart Museum works for the academic year.
cards.source_title: Unique Traditions | The College | The University of Chicago
cards.access_notes: Available to students living in College housing; consult the program for participation details.

cards.title: Join the four-day Scav Hunt
cards.subtitle: Annual campus-wide hunt
cards.notes: Follow the official Hunt when its list is released in May, then watch or participate in its items, events, Olympics, and final judging.
cards.short_summary: An annual four-day scavenger hunt that has run at UChicago since 1987.
cards.evidence_claim: The official Scav Hunt site says UChicago has hosted the event every May since 1987 and that it spans four days.
cards.access_notes: Held annually in May; the precise list and events change each year.

cards.title: Hear the Latke-Hamantash case
cards.subtitle: Faculty comic debate
cards.notes: Attend the debate to hear faculty make scholarly, deliberately humorous cases for latkes or hamantashen rather than seeking a final culinary verdict.
cards.short_summary: A faculty debate that applies academic argument to two Jewish holiday foods.
cards.evidence_claim: UChicago states that the Latke-Hamantash Debate was created there in 1946 and features faculty arguments grounded in their disciplines and humor.
cards.source_title: Unique Traditions | The College | The University of Chicago
cards.access_notes: Check University event listings for the next presentation.

cards.title: Make Wednesday a Shake Day
cards.subtitle: Reynolds Club weekly ritual
cards.notes: Stop by the Reynolds Club on an academic-year Wednesday if you want to take part in the longstanding milkshake-and-toppings gathering.
cards.short_summary: A weekly Reynolds Club milkshake tradition during the academic year.
cards.evidence_claim: UChicago describes Dollar Shake Days as an academic-year Wednesday gathering in Reynolds Club for a one-dollar milkshake with free toppings.
cards.source_title: Unique Traditions | The College | The University of Chicago
cards.access_notes: The College identifies Wednesdays during the academic year; confirm current dining availability before going.

cards.title: Mind the gold seal
cards.subtitle: Reynolds Club superstition
cards.notes: Look down when crossing the Reynolds Club and decide for yourself whether to detour around the gold seal that students say affects graduation timing.
cards.short_summary: A longstanding campus belief warns students not to step on the Reynolds Club's gold seal.
cards.evidence_claim: The College documents a longstanding belief that students who step on the Reynolds Club gold seal will not graduate on time.
cards.source_title: Unique Traditions | The College | The University of Chicago
cards.access_notes: Located in Reynolds Club; this is a documented superstition, not a University rule.

cards.title: Start winter quarter before dawn
cards.subtitle: Weeklong winter festival
cards.notes: Choose a dawn activity during Kuvia, then follow the final-day schedule for lakefront sun salutations and the race across the quads.
cards.short_summary: A weeklong winter festival of early-morning activities and a final-day Quad race.
cards.evidence_claim: UChicago describes Kuvia as a weeklong winter festival with dawn activities, lakefront sun salutations, and a race across the quads.
cards.source_title: Unique Traditions | The College | The University of Chicago
cards.access_notes: Occurs as winter quarter begins; activity details vary by year.

cards.title: Close spring quarter at Summer Breeze
cards.subtitle: Annual end-of-year festival
cards.notes: Check the annual program for daytime food and games, then stay for the outdoor concert that marks the close of spring quarter.
cards.short_summary: A spring-quarter festival with games, food, and an outdoor concert.
cards.evidence_claim: UChicago says the Council on University Programming and Major Activities Board host Summer Breeze each spring quarter with food, games, and a nighttime outdoor concert.
cards.source_title: Unique Traditions | The College | The University of Chicago
cards.access_notes: Held during spring quarter; consult current event announcements for date and location.

cards.title: Walk through Cobb Gate
cards.subtitle: Orientation Week arrival rite
cards.notes: During Orientation Week, follow the Pipe Band procession after opening convocation and pass through Cobb Gate with your incoming class.
cards.short_summary: First-year students process through Cobb Gate during Orientation Week.
cards.evidence_claim: UChicago's anniversary site describes an annual Orientation Week tradition in which incoming first-years follow the University of Chicago Pipe Band and continue through Cobb Gate.
cards.source_title: Cobb Gate | University of Chicago 125th Anniversary
cards.access_notes: For incoming first-year students during Orientation Week; timing is set by the College's orientation schedule.

cards.title: Begin with the Aims address
cards.subtitle: Orientation Week academic rite
cards.notes: Put the annual first-year address on your Orientation Week calendar and use it as a starting point for conversations about what education means at UChicago.
cards.short_summary: An annual address to first-year College students during Orientation Week.
cards.evidence_claim: The University of Chicago Magazine identifies the Aims of Education address as an Orientation Week event delivered to first-year College students.
cards.source_title: Autumn rites | The University of Chicago Magazine
cards.access_notes: Presented during Orientation Week for first-year College students; verify the current program schedule.

cards.entity_name: University of Chicago Folk Festival Bagpipe Opening
cards.title: Follow the Folk Festival bagpipes
cards.subtitle: Annual festival opening
cards.notes: Arrive for the opening of the UChicago Folk Festival to hear the bagpipe-led start before exploring the weekend's traditional-music program.
cards.short_summary: Bagpipes inaugurate the University of Chicago Folk Festival each year.
cards.evidence_claim: The University of Chicago Magazine reports that every UChicago Folk Festival begins with bagpipes and describes the festival's long-running student-organized history.
cards.source_title: Sounds reborn | The University of Chicago Magazine
cards.access_notes: Festival programming and venue vary; confirm the current Folk Festival schedule.
